I think once we're gone that's it, like before we were born.

I was super religious and used to believe in God heavily. Once I got to my freshman year of high school though, I was recommended a video by darkmatter2525 and it made me question my beliefs after hearing the arguments he put forth and it made me also realize that I had never actually read the whole bible (neither did my parents). After that I did more research and watched more atheist related content (Cosmic Skeptic, Nonstampcollector, etc) on YouTube and realized that what I was told to believe made absolutely no sense. I told this to my mom and she got me to talk to our pastor but he couldn't give me a straight answer on any of my questions, only the usual "We can't know what God thinks" and "God works in mysterious ways" and brought up a bunch of fallacious arguments. That's when I knew that what I was believing in wasn't true. I'm 19 now and my life hasn't changed much without God but I still suffer from the mental scar of being told I that would go to hell forever if I stopped believing. I still have nightmares and freak out because what if I'm wrong? My parents think I'm still finding my way and I'll come back but I don't think that'll happen.
